rowCells:
□ 기존의 GVM을 WIPI플랫폼을 이용한 변환개발 및 기능개선
□ Downloadable 형태의 WIPI application으로 game player의 기능을 가지고 있음
sktPrimarySource.assessment: The operator report describes development of a downloadable WIPI application that acts as a GNEX game player. This supports a deployment architecture; it neither supplies the player binary nor establishes installation on every WIPI handset or on SCH-S390.
sktPrimarySource.limits: Only the cover identity and relevant development row/context were specifically reviewed. The full original HTML is preserved, not every financial section re-audited.

limits: A model-labelled BIN is not proof of a complete flash dump, bootable phone or working interpreter. No phone code or downloaded software executed.
SGS v1/v2/v4/v36 plain/XOR-A5 scans cover the input and all53 embedded ZIP file payloads. Unknown compression, fragmentation, encrypted/ROMized/native games remain unresolved.
The exact embedded ZIP is Samsung input-method/UI material, not identified as Bomb Link or Bejeweled. Only its real bytes and bounded excerpts are exported separately.
The SKT filing supports the downloadable WIPI-player architecture, not installation on all WIPI devices or specifically this SCH-S390 image.
Original support/filing HTML bodies are retained; dependent website assets are not a complete offline website capture.
No current remote body equality is inferred merely from a matching catalog filename, fileID or size.
Original source notices and rights remain separate from Reunion MIT.
